title: POSTCARDS FROM THE OTHER TOWN · IV
venue: Arthur's site · a romance the strip never ran · eight cards · Box 19
logline: His: the front is a bus stop shelter with a bench, drawn the size of a cathedral, the schedule case a rose window; the back, one word.

panels.composition: The postcard's front: a roadside bus shelter drawn the size of a cathedral, its schedule case a rose window, a tiny bench inside.

image.prompt: two-color coastal weekly illustration, a roadside bus shelter drawn the size of a cathedral with its schedule case drawn as a rose window and a tiny bench inside, no words legible

panels.name: Front

panels.composition: The postcard's back: the message side with the fourth word legible and a crossed-out line beneath it.

image.prompt: the back of a postcard drawn in ink, a divided back with an address side and a message side, the handwriting rendered as strokes with one word left legible, a small stamp with a tiny numeral in its corner, a crossed-out line of strokes beneath the message, the only legible word on the card is here
image.notes: The crossed-out line: reserved. The first four words: the sentence the canon's 2008 postcard already said. The one legible word: here. Stamp numeral: III.

panels.name: Back

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink for the fronts; the backs in a stranger's hand, drawn as shapes but for one word each
art.palette: the fronts in the coastal weekly's two-color; the stamps in one color each
art.paper: cardstock cut to postcard size, drawn both sides, photographed as spreads
